classification.difficultyReason: Compare explicitly labelled coordinate pairs and identify the constant y-coordinate on the horizontal line and constant x-coordinate on the vertical line.

content.prompt: Compare the coordinates of points on horizontal and vertical lines.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What is the same about the coordinates of all four points on this horizontal line?

answer.worked: All four points have the same $y$-coordinate, $3$. Their $x$-coordinates vary.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What is the same about the coordinates of all four points on this vertical line?

answer.worked: All four points have the same $x$-coordinate, $2$. Their $y$-coordinates vary.
